description: Explore Growing Kids daycare and preschool in South Bend, Indiana. Compare centers, programs, tuition support and tour options.
html:
Daycare and Preschool in South Bend, Indiana

Growing Kids Learning Centers operates three daycare and preschool centers in South Bend, on Ireland Road, State Road 23 and Bendix Drive. All three are NECPA accredited, hold Indiana’s Level 4 Paths to QUALITY rating and serve children from six weeks through age 12. Centers open between 5:45 and 6:30 am and close at 6:00 pm, Monday through Friday. Each building was custom built for child care, with one monitored entrance, biometric check-in and classroom cameras.

Schedule a TourCall (574) 299-4979See all South Bend centers

Looking for infant care? Confirm your room’s drop-off time with the center; the infant program page lists a 7:00 am opening.

Three centers. Find your everyday stop.

Choose the South Bend center that fits your route. Each offers the full range of programs, from infant care through school age.

Growing Kids on Ireland Road

17850 Ireland Rd, South Bend, IN 46614
(574) 299-4979

Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 6:00 pm

The Ireland Road center moved into a brand new building with the same teachers and families, so you get new classrooms and playgrounds without a new staff. It sits on the southeast side with quick access to US 20, the bypass and the Ireland Road retail corridor, which makes it the natural pick for families commuting toward Mishawaka or Elkhart.

Schedule a Tour at Ireland RoadView Center Page

Growing Kids on State Road 23

17475 State Road 23, South Bend, IN 46635
(574) 273-9048

Monday to Friday, 6:30 am to 6:00 pm

The State Road 23 center is tucked back from the road with a large playground surrounded by trees, which gives it a quieter feel than its address suggests. Onsite parking makes drop-off quick. It is the closest Growing Kids center to Notre Dame, Granger and the north side of Mishawaka.

Schedule a Tour at State Road 23View Center Page

Growing Kids on Bendix Drive

2601 N. Bendix Drive, South Bend, IN 46628
(574) 288-3992

Monday to Friday, 5:45 am to 6:00 pm

Bendix Drive opens earliest of the three South Bend centers, at 5:45 am, which matters for parents on early shifts near the airport, the hospital corridor and the west side industrial parks. Onsite parking, daily outdoor play on the playgrounds and the full infant through school age range.

Schedule a Tour at Bendix DriveView Center Page

Programs for every stage

Every South Bend center runs the full program ladder, so a child can start as an infant and stay through elementary school without changing buildings.

ProgramAgesWhat it is
Infants6 weeks until walkingLow ratios, your feeding and nap schedule, daily updates.
Toddlers and Young PreschoolWalking to 3 yearsLearning through motion and movement, first friends, early language.
Preschool3 to 5 yearsELM (Early Learning Matters) curriculum built for kindergarten readiness.
School Age Care5 to 12 yearsBefore and after school care plus full days on snow days, delays and breaks.
Camps5 to 12 yearsSummer and school break camps with weekly themes.

Why South Bend families choose Growing Kids

Three centers, one standard. Ireland Road, State Road 23 and Bendix Drive all carry the same NECPA accreditation and the same Level 4 Paths to QUALITY rating, so the choice comes down to which drive works for your family, not which center is better.

Security designed by people who do it for a living. Growing Kids' safety protocols were designed with a child care security company run by former Secret Service agents. Every building has one locked, monitored entrance, biometric check-in and check-out, cameras in every classroom and an emergency call system in every room, with emergency plans coordinated with local police and fire departments.

Main Street. At the heart of each center is Main Street, a child sized mini town where kids play through real life, running a cafe, a post office and a store. It is the thing parents remember from the tour and the thing kids talk about at dinner.

Hours that fit real schedules. The earliest South Bend door opens at 5:45 am and all three stay open until 6:00 pm. Growing Kids closes only eight days a year, so two hour delays, snow days and teacher in-service days are covered.

Accredited, not just licensed. Indiana licensing is the floor. NECPA accreditation and a Level 4 Paths to QUALITY rating are earned on top of it. Every Growing Kids center also participates in CCDF vouchers and On My Way Pre-K.

Thirty years in the community. Growing Kids is family owned and has been serving Northern Indiana families for three decades.

What daycare costs in South Bend

Tuition at Growing Kids depends on your child's age, the days you need and the center, so the accurate number comes from the center you are touring. Call Ireland Road, State Road 23 or Bendix Drive and ask for current weekly rates, or request them when you book a tour.

Several things can bring the cost down. All Growing Kids centers accept Indiana CCDF child care vouchers and participate in On My Way Pre-K, which provides free prekindergarten for families who qualify. Families who set up weekly AutoPay earn a weekly tuition discount. The Refer-a-Friend program typically credits $100 to the referring family and $100 to the new family, with no cap on referrals. Growing Kids also has child care benefit arrangements with a number of area employers, so it is worth asking HR whether yours is one of them.

Ask about tuition support and discounts

Close to home. On the way to work.

Families come to the South Bend centers from across St. Joseph County and just over the Michigan line. Ireland Road draws from the southeast side, Mishawaka, Osceola and the US 20 corridor. State Road 23 serves the north side, Granger, Roseland, the Notre Dame area and northern Mishawaka. Bendix Drive serves the west and northwest side, the airport area, New Carlisle, North Liberty and commuters coming in on US 31 and US 20. Parents who work downtown, at the hospitals or on campus can usually find a center on the way in.

Your South Bend daycare questions, answered

Is Growing Kids a daycare or a preschool?

Both. Growing Kids is a licensed, nationally accredited child care center that runs a ELM (Early Learning Matters) curriculum with Conscious Discipline built around kindergarten readiness. Children can enroll at six weeks and stay through age 12, with infant care, toddler, preschool, school age care and camps all in the same building.

Which Growing Kids center in South Bend is closest to me?

There are three. Ireland Road (17850 Ireland Rd) is on the southeast side near Mishawaka. State Road 23 (17475 State Road 23) is on the north side near Notre Dame and Granger. Bendix Drive (2601 N. Bendix Drive) is on the northwest side near the airport. All three serve the same ages and hold the same accreditation.

What time does Growing Kids open in South Bend?

Bendix Drive opens at 5:45 am, Ireland Road at 6:00 am and State Road 23 at 6:30 am. All three close at 6:00 pm, Monday through Friday. The published infant program page lists infant rooms opening at 7:00 am; confirm your infant’s drop-off time with the center.

Does Growing Kids take infants?

Yes. The infant program accepts babies from six weeks old until they are walking, with low teacher to child ratios and your own feeding and nap schedule. Infant spots fill fastest, so pre-register early is a good idea.

Is Growing Kids accredited?

Yes. Every Growing Kids center is accredited by the National Early Childhood Program Accreditation (NECPA) and holds a Level 4 rating from Indiana's Paths to QUALITY, the highest level the state awards.

How much is daycare in South Bend at Growing Kids?

Rates depend on age, schedule and center, so the center gives you a current quote. Growing Kids accepts CCDF vouchers, participates in On My Way Pre-K, offers an AutoPay discount and a Refer-a-Friend credit. It also has benefit arrangements with several local employers.

How does Growing Kids keep kids safe?

Each building has one locked entrance that is always monitored, biometric check-in for parents, security cameras in every classroom and an emergency call system in every room. The protocols were designed with a security firm run by former Secret Service agents and are coordinated with local police and fire.

Does Growing Kids offer before and after school care in South Bend?

Yes, the School Age program covers children 5 to 12 before and after school, plus full day care on two hour delays, snow days and school breaks. Ask the center about transportation to and from your child's school.

How many days a year is Growing Kids closed?

Eight. Growing Kids stays open on most school holidays and on weather days when schools close.

How do I tour a Growing Kids center in South Bend?

Book online at growingkids.com/book-a-tour or call the center directly. Tours take about 30 minutes and children are welcome. You can also pre-register online if your preferred classroom is full.

Come See It For Yourself

Pick the South Bend center on your route and book a 30 minute tour. Bring your child, see Main Street and meet the teachers.

Schedule a TourCall (574) 299-4979See all South Bend centers
Growing Kids also serves families in Elkhart, Goshen, Valparaiso, Chesterton, Plymouth, Warsaw.

description: Explore Growing Kids daycare and preschool in Goshen, Indiana. Compare centers, programs, tuition support and tour options.
html:
Daycare and Preschool in Goshen, Indiana

Growing Kids on Elkhart Road provides daycare and preschool in Goshen, Indiana, for children from six weeks through age 12. The center is NECPA accredited and holds Indiana’s Level 4 Paths to QUALITY rating. It opens 6:00 am to 6:00 pm Monday through Friday, just off County Road 17 at Peddlers Village Road. Families will find monitored entry, biometric check-in, playgrounds separated by age and a Main Street mini town.

Schedule a TourCall (574) 875-8005View the Goshen center page

Looking for infant care? Confirm your room’s drop-off time with the center; the infant program page lists a 7:00 am opening.

Goshen at a glance

Centers in Goshen1
Address

3212 Elkhart Road, Goshen, IN 46526

Phone

(574) 875-8005

Hours

Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 6:00 pm

Your Goshen center

Growing Kids on Elkhart Road

3212 Elkhart Road, Goshen, IN 46526
(574) 875-8005

Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 6:00 pm

The Goshen center is on Elkhart Road (US 33) just off County Road 17 and Peddlers Village Road, which puts it on the direct line between Goshen and the Elkhart employers to the north. Groceries, pharmacy and gas are all within a couple of minutes, so errands fit around pick-up. Onsite parking makes the hand-off quick. Playgrounds are separated by age so toddlers and school age kids each have space built for them. Classrooms are cleaned throughout the day by in-house staff and sanitized nightly.

Schedule a Tour at Elkhart RoadView Center Page

Programs for every stage

The Goshen center runs the full program ladder, so a child can start as an infant and stay through elementary school in the same building.

ProgramAgesWhat it is
Infants6 weeks until walkingLow ratios, your feeding and nap schedule, daily updates.
Toddlers and Young PreschoolWalking to 3 yearsLearning through motion and movement, first friends, early language.
Preschool3 to 5 yearsELM (Early Learning Matters) curriculum built for kindergarten readiness.
School Age Care5 to 12 yearsBefore and after school care plus full days on snow days, delays and breaks.
Camps5 to 12 yearsSummer and school break camps with weekly themes.

Why Goshen families choose Growing Kids

On the way, not out of the way. Elkhart Road at County Road 17 is the route most Goshen families already drive. Drop-off adds minutes, not a detour.

Security designed by people who do it for a living. Growing Kids' safety protocols were designed with a child care security company run by former Secret Service agents. One locked, monitored entrance, biometric check-in and check-out, cameras in every classroom and an emergency call system in every room, coordinated with local police and fire departments.

Main Street. At the heart of the center is Main Street, a child sized mini town where kids play through real life, running a cafe, a post office and a store.

Playgrounds built by age. Separate age appropriate play areas mean a two year old is never sharing equipment with a ten year old.

Accredited, not just licensed. Indiana licensing is the floor. NECPA accreditation and a Level 4 Paths to QUALITY rating are earned on top of it. The Goshen center participates in CCDF vouchers and On My Way Pre-K.

Open when schools are not. Eight closure days a year. Two hour delays, snow days and in-service days are covered for school age kids.

What daycare costs in Goshen

Tuition at Growing Kids depends on your child's age and the days you need, so the accurate number comes from the center. Call Elkhart Road and ask for current weekly rates, or request them when you book a tour.

Several things can bring the cost down. The Goshen center accepts Indiana CCDF child care vouchers and participates in On My Way Pre-K, which provides free prekindergarten for families who qualify. Families who set up weekly AutoPay earn a weekly tuition discount. The Refer-a-Friend program typically credits $100 to the referring family and $100 to the new family, with no cap. Growing Kids also has child care benefit arrangements with a number of area employers, so ask HR whether yours is one of them.

Ask about tuition support and discounts

Close to home. On the way to work.

Families come to the Goshen center from across the south half of Elkhart County, including Dunlap, Waterford Mills, New Paris, Wakarusa, Millersburg, Benton and Middlebury, and from the north edge of Kosciusko County around Syracuse and Milford. Parents who work in Elkhart's north side plants often choose Goshen because the center is on the way home rather than past it.

Your Goshen daycare questions, answered

Is there an accredited daycare in Goshen, Indiana?

Yes. Growing Kids Learning Center at 3212 Elkhart Road is accredited by the National Early Childhood Program Accreditation (NECPA) and holds a Level 4 rating from Indiana's Paths to QUALITY, the highest level the state awards.

Does Growing Kids in Goshen take infants?

Yes. The infant program accepts babies from six weeks old until they are walking, with low teacher to child ratios and your own feeding and nap schedule. Infant rooms fill first, so pre-register early.

What are the hours at the Goshen center?

6:00 am to 6:00 pm, Monday through Friday, with only eight closure days a year.

Where is the Goshen center?

3212 Elkhart Road, Goshen, IN 46526, on US 33 just off County Road 17 at Peddlers Village Road.

How much is daycare in Goshen at Growing Kids?

Rates depend on age and schedule, so the center gives you a current quote. Growing Kids accepts CCDF vouchers, participates in On My Way Pre-K, offers an AutoPay discount and a Refer-a-Friend credit. It also has benefit arrangements with several area employers.

Does Growing Kids Goshen offer On My Way Pre-K?

Yes. All Growing Kids centers participate in Indiana's On My Way Pre-K program, which provides free prekindergarten for families who qualify. Complete the state’s eligibility process and tell the center you have been approved.

Does Growing Kids offer before and after school care in Goshen?

Yes. The School Age program covers children 5 to 12 before and after school, plus full days on two hour delays, snow days and breaks. Ask the center about transportation to and from your child's school.

How does the Goshen center keep kids safe?

One locked entrance that is always monitored, biometric check-in for parents, security cameras in every classroom and an emergency call system in every room. The protocols were designed with a security firm run by former Secret Service agents.

Is there a preschool program or just daycare?

Both. Preschool for ages 3 to 5 runs on the ELM (Early Learning Matters) curriculum and is built around kindergarten readiness. Younger children move up from the infant and toddler rooms when they are ready.

How do I schedule a tour in Goshen?

Book online at growingkids.com/book-a-tour or call (574) 875-8005. Tours take about 30 minutes and children are welcome.

Come See It For Yourself

Book a 30 minute tour at Elkhart Road. Bring your child, see Main Street and meet the teachers.

Schedule a TourCall (574) 875-8005View the Goshen center page
Growing Kids also serves families in South Bend, Elkhart, Valparaiso, Chesterton, Plymouth, Warsaw.
